All constructions

Every record, grouped by problem, with links to the record file, its exact certificate and its float check on GitHub. Open a problem to see its 39 values of n.

3,185 selected coordinate constructions are certified exactly; 9 better published entries link to the original constructions and have no coordinates or local certificate. Their certified alternatives remain available in the viewer. The same files are in records/; SUMMARY.csv and SUMMARY_families.csv list the project archive values; external_records.json lists independent sources, and data/records.json holds all selected values and alternatives shown on this site. Download the whole repository.
